evals.prompt: I'm preparing a routine bulk status notification. The visible roots are Billing cleanup (In progress), Release checklist (Completed), Search indexing (In progress, currently working), and Vendor access (Blocked on external party). I did not ask to resume anything. Which roots are in scope by default? Do not send any messages.
evals.expected_output: The agent excludes the Completed root by default while retaining the other visible roots, and explains that Completed is treated like archived work unless explicitly included or resumed.
expectations: The in-scope roots are Billing cleanup, Search indexing, and Vendor access.
Release checklist is excluded because Completed roots are out of scope by default.
The response does not claim that Blocked on external party or In progress roots are automatically excluded.

evals.prompt: You're the agent on a root bb thread. You just finished a draft migration plan and your last message asks me to pick between two rollout options before you continue. Before you end your turn, should this thread change stage? If so, give the exact bb thread-stages command you would run; if not, say why. Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Move to Blocked on user because the rollout decision is required and no independent work remains.
expectations: Selects Blocked on user rather than Waiting or In progress.
Proposes `bb thread-stages stage BlockedOnUser --self`.
Does not load Thread actions for this stage-only request.

evals.prompt: Two root bb threads I own are stuck. Thread A can't continue until another bb thread lands the auth refactor it depends on. expectations: Thread A is placed in Blocked on another thread with `bb thread-stages stage BlockedOnOtherAgent <thread-a>`.
Thread B is placed in Blocked on external party with `bb thread-stages stage BlockedOnThirdParty <thread-b>`.
